Gender: Prescriptions are given to both males and females, with a slight female predominance for Bipolar Disorder and male predominance for Schizophrenia in the USA.

Efficacy: Levothyroxine is over 95% effective in reversing symptoms of hypothyroidism when dosed appropriately.
Safety: Generally regarded as safe; routine monitoring is essential to avoid overtreatment or undertreatment.

Symptoms: Breast lump, pain in the breast or chest, swelling of the breast, changes in breast shape, and metastasis symptoms depending on affected organs (e.g., bone pain, respiratory issues).
